About Krystal

Krystal is an internet services company specialising in a range of tools, solutions & services for businesses all over the world. From web hosting and cloud services to voice over IP and customer support platforms, we've been the purveyors of the internet since 2002.

Our Creed

Remaining true to our creed since 2002, we firmly believe business is about solving problems and not making money. Exemplary service and technical proficiency is in our DNA.

Our Creed

Protecting the Planet

We're incredibly proud of our green credentials and in 2017 became one of the first web hosts to run our entire infrastructure on 100% renewable energy. We plant lots of trees too! Read about our green credentials!

Protecting the Planet

Technology

We only deploy the very best hardware and software, finely tuned for maximum performance, across our ever-growing fleet of servers. We continually re-invest profits to ever improve our product.
